title: Pyar Jhukta Nahin
desc: Ajay and Preeti marry despite her parents' disapproval. Bhanu, her father, interferes constantly, creating troubles and trying to separate them, testing their love and determination to stay together.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
desc: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Ayassh Dil
desc: Malay is a successful journalist, but his personal life spins out of control when he gets romantically involved with several women despite being married.

title: Jabariya Jodi
desc: Abhay, a righteous thug, kidnaps greedy grooms who demand dowry and gets them married without it. His childhood love Babli returns, making him rethink his life and priorities.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Woh Bhi Din The
desc: Rohit, a photojournalist, returns to his school as a speaker. He relives his carefree days and the moment he first fell in love, filled with nostalgia.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali loves Dev, but family pressure forces her to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to win her back, only to find she has grown to love her husband.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.
